name: Kimi K3
definition: Kimi K3 is an open-weight Kimi K3 model by Moonshot AI focused on long-horizon coding, knowledge work and multimodal agents.

license.name: Kimi K3 License
license.commercial_use: Review the exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: Large datacenter / multi-GPU class. The model's 2.8T total parameter pool dominates storage and sharding requirements.

deployment.summary: The official weights are published for independent deployment; practical serving requires a large distributed inference stack.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
